Recorded claim:
Persisted Patch Review state may contain `status: error`, `error: "Selected model is at capacity. Please try a different model."`, and stale `message: "Command completed"`. Late activity may still be recorded, but `recordGraphPatchUpdateCodexNotification` must not overwrite `session.message` after an error; render `session.error` before `session.message`. [Task 11]
